children: Vietnam’s Deputy Prime Minister Nguyen Van Thang reiterated to US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer that the country is ready for “open, constructive” trade talks, according to Bloomberg.
The remarks came as Vietnam seeks to revive months-long negotiations over a final tariff deal with the Trump administration.

title: Vietnam Reaffirms Readiness for US Trade Talks
